title: Whole Blood Measurements from the SpaceX Inspiration4 Mission (RNA-seq, epitranscriptome, WGS, clonal hematopoiesis, CBC)
assays: Complete Blood Count (CBC - Sysmex XN Hematology Analyzer)
Whole Genome Sequencing (WGS) & Clonal Hematopoiesis Panel

protocols.sample_collection: 4mL whole blood in K2 EDTA tubes for CBC; 2.5mL in PAXgene tubes for RNA-seq.

diagnostic_explanation: Spaceflight stress triggers acute leukocyte mobilization (elevated WBC and neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio) alongside hemoconcentration from plasma volume loss.
